name: Zephyros
source:
Zephyros, an arcane dropout, is driven by a profound desire to cure his loved ones of a deadly plague that has befallen his village. He tends to be overly self-sacrificing, often neglecting his own well-being in his pursuit of helping others.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747560/Spellbound_Hearts/]Steam[/url]]
